requirements.label: 120 Total Credits
requirements.hint: The degree requires a minimum of 120 credits and leads to State of Michigan elementary certification (PK-3 or 3-6, all subjects). Dual degrees are not available with this program.

requirements.label: Education core, years 1-2 (8 courses)
requirements.hint: EDUC 118, 141, 151, 160, 241, 271, 291, and 392: the pre-professional education sequence.

requirements.label: EDUC electives (6 credits)
requirements.hint: Two education courses beyond the required sequence.

requirements.label: First-year writing
requirements.hint: One course fulfilling the First-Year Writing Requirement.

requirements.label: Natural science (6 credits)
requirements.hint: Two courses in different natural science disciplines (astronomy, biology, chemistry, earth science, physics, or environmental science). AP/IB credit does not count; the different-discipline rule is not auto-checked.

requirements.label: Social science (6 credits)
requirements.hint: Two courses in different social science disciplines (civics/political science, economics, history, or geography). AP/IB credit does not count; the different-discipline rule is not auto-checked.

requirements.label: Professional sequence, years 3-4 (16 courses)
requirements.hint: The elementary methods core: EDUC 303, 391, the four-course literacy sequence (401, 403, 405, 407), mathematics and science methods (411, 415, 416, 421), 414, 417, 430, 431, and the two-module courses 443 and 444.

requirements.label: Practicum (EDUC 307, 6 credits)
requirements.hint: Two credits per semester across three semesters alongside the professional sequence. Each completed term counts; a planned term registers once, so log each term as taken when it finishes.
